headline: The APO is built — one admin step left for you
note: Soundstage no longer needs VB-CABLE. The plugin builds, the app publishes settings to it live, and both sides agree on the data byte for byte (33/33 checks). The one thing I couldn't do is install it: attaching a plugin to a speaker needs Administrator. Run install-apo.ps1 as admin when you're back. It backs up everything it touches and -Uninstall puts it all back.

items.text: Gain reduction on the Leveler dial
Soundstage APO - our own audio plugin
App publishes settings to the plugin, live
Layouts verified across C# and C++ (33/33)
Installer script with full backup and undo
YOU: run install-apo.ps1 as admin to switch it on
